_comment: Read by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry accepts ONE advisory for ONE package until `expires` (UTC date, exclusive). Only HIGH can be accepted, only when npm offers no fix inside the declared range (none, or a semver-major one). Renewing an entry is a reviewed change, not an edit to keep CI green.

exceptions.justification: Memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections: a denial of service of the process doing the validation, with no data exposure. The only fix is zod >= 4.6.6, a major that changes the public types of @codespar/api-types and @codespar/sdk consumed by codespar-enterprise and codespar-web; no patched 3.x exists. The zod 4 migration is tracked in #214 with the coordinated bumps.
